source_title: Beyond agency boundaries: Building a statewide approach to customer experience
key_message: State satisfaction spreads by 37–40 percentage points in two reported services.
data_recipe: Collect comparable resident service ratings by state
message_conditions: Comparable service questions and time window
Extremes are not averages or causal effects
design_moves: Editorial interval plot from two reported ranges
diff_notes: Original SVGZ unavailable, two published ranges redrawn editorially, not original reproduction.

training_pair.instruction: Make a reusable 2-service state satisfaction interval plot without inventing state-level observations.
training_pair.response: Exact executable chart code: chart.py; original quantitative input: data.csv; layout/colors/text: config.json. Run python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png (or --theme neutral). All variables are declared in the bundle; source figures are not included.
